title: No-Poach Agreements
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study no-poach cartels using a wage-posting model that puts worker poaching at the center of labor market competition. Even when just two out of ten employers in a local labor market collude, wages fall by almost 5% market-wide. The reason is that no-poach agreements suppress competition along the job ladder, with spillovers to non-colluding firms. We then compare no-poach agreements to two other forms of anti-competitive conduct in the labor market: noncompete agreements and wage fixing. No-poach agreements have by far the largest negative wage effects.

title: Income Gradients in Health-State Dependence
title_zh: 健康状态依赖中的收入梯度
authors: De Donder, Philippe, Lefèvre, François, Leroux, Marie-Louise, Roquebert, Quitterie
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates how marginal utility varies with health status (e.g. health-state dependence) while allowing this relationship to differ across income levels. Building on the existing literature, we develop a framework that quantifies the income adjustments necessary to maintain individuals’ wellbeing when they become disabled. Using SHARE data, we empirically estimate how health affects the marginal utility of consumption across the income distribution for older adults in Europe. Our results show that health-state dependence is negative among low-income individuals, indicating that their marginal utility of consumption declines when their health worsens. In contrast, at the very top of the income distribution, health-state dependence is positive, implying that marginal utility of consumption rises as health deteriorates.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了边际效用如何随健康状况变化（即健康状态依赖性），并允许这种关系在不同收入水平上存在差异。在现有文献基础上，我们构建了一个框架，用以量化个体在残疾时维持其福祉所需的收入调整。利用SHARE数据，我们实证估计了健康如何影响欧洲老年人消费边际效用的收入分布差异。研究结果表明，低收入群体的健康状态依赖性为负，即其健康状况恶化时消费边际效用下降。相反，在收入分布顶端，健康状态依赖性为正，意味着健康状况恶化时消费边际效用上升。

title: A Bibliometric Exploration of Tourist Satisfaction and Quality
title_zh: 旅游满意度与质量的文献计量探索
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The bibliometric analysis delves into the progression and influence of research concerning the quality of tourism, emphasizing the patterns, inputs, and thematic advancements within the domain. According to the study, conference papers provide a lesser percentage of insightful material than journal articles, which indicates a strong emphasis on peer-reviewed research and accounts for the majority of relevant literature. Since 1983, the field of study has changed dramatically. Notable growth began in the late 1990s and peaked in the most recent years, indicating a rise in scholarly interest in high-quality tourism. Important journals like "The Journal of Quality Assurance in Hospitality and Tourism," "Sustainability Switzerland," and "Tourism Management," are crucial in influencing the conversation. Keywords that stand out are "quality of life," "tourism," and "sustainability," with an emphasis on global viewpoints, particularly as they relate to China. The field has advanced thanks to significant contributions from people like Carneiro, Eusébio, and Uysal as well as organizations like Universidade Q9 and the Hong Kong Polytechnic University. Strong international cooperation is highlighted by the citation network, which shows strong connections between China, the United States, the United Kingdom, Spain, and Portugal. The study emphasizes a multidisciplinary strategy that integrates environmental and managerial factors into the quality of tourism. Although the study offers a thorough overview, its limitations include methodological issues, temporal and linguistic biases, and dependence on particular data sources. All things considered, the analysis presents a vibrant and cooperative field characterized by significant scholarly involvement and an increasing focus on sustainability and interdisciplinary research.
abstract_zh: 文献计量分析深入探讨了旅游质量研究的进展与影响力，重点关注该领域的模式、投入及主题演进。研究表明，会议论文提供的洞察性材料占比低于期刊论文，这表明同行评审研究受到高度重视，并构成了相关文献的主体。自1983年以来，该研究领域发生了显著变化。显著增长始于20世纪90年代末，并在最近几年达到顶峰，反映出学术界对高质量旅游的兴趣日益浓厚。《酒店与旅游质量保证期刊》、《瑞士可持续发展》和《旅游管理》等重要期刊在引导学术讨论中发挥了关键作用。突出的关键词包括“生活质量”、“旅游”和“可持续性”，尤其关注全球视角，特别是与中国相关的研究。Carneiro、Eusébio和Uysal等学者以及Universidade Q9和香港理工大学等机构为该领域的进步做出了重要贡献。引文网络凸显了强大的国际合作，显示中国、美国、英国、西班牙和葡萄牙之间存在紧密联系。研究强调了一种跨学科策略，将环境和管理因素融入旅游质量中。尽管该研究提供了全面的概述，但其局限性包括方法论问题、时间与语言偏差，以及对特定数据源的依赖。总体而言，该分析呈现了一个充满活力且协作性强的领域，其特点是显著的学术参与度，以及对可持续性和跨学科研究的日益关注。

title:
Trade Effects of
                    EU
                    Sanctions Against Russia: Evidence From the Visegrad Group
title_zh: 欧盟对俄制裁的贸易效应：来自维谢格拉德集团的证据
authors: Agnieszka Głodowska, Agnieszka Hajdukiewicz, Bożena Pera, Csaba Weiner
abstract: This article examines the impact of the European Union's post‐March 2014 and post‐February 2022 sanctions episodes against Russia on trade between Russia and the Visegrad countries (Czechia, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia) over 2013–2024. Changes are analysed at both the aggregate level and—based on an original identification of EU sanction coverage—across selected sanctioned product chapters and non‐sanctioned reference groups. The empirical framework combines descriptive statistics on the distribution of the selected product groups with two complementary econometric approaches: a gravity‐based Poisson pseudo‐maximum likelihood model (PPML) with fixed effects, estimated in a difference‐in‐differences design relative to control markets, and a PPML interrupted time‐series model used as a robustness check to identify structural breaks and post‐intervention trends. Empirically, the effects of EU sanctions on Visegrad exports to Russia were strongly negative already under the post‐March 2014 sanctions regime, particularly for highly sanctioned manufactured product groups such as machinery and electrical equipment, and intensified further following the substantial expansion of sanctions after February 2022. Import effects were initially weaker but intensified markedly from 2022 onward, most notably for energy sources. The findings point to episode‐specific trade responses, pronounced heterogeneity across product groups, and a clear asymmetry between export and import adjustments.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2013—2024年间，欧盟在2014年3月后及2022年2月后对俄罗斯实施的两轮制裁对俄罗斯与维谢格拉德国家（捷克、匈牙利、波兰和斯洛伐克）之间贸易的影响。分析涵盖总体层面，并基于对欧盟制裁覆盖范围的原创识别，在选定的受制裁产品章节和未受制裁参考组之间展开。实证框架结合了所选产品组分布的描述性统计与两种互补的计量经济学方法：一是基于引力模型的泊松伪最大似然估计（PPML）固定效应模型，采用双重差分设计相对于对照市场进行估计；二是作为稳健性检验的PPML中断时间序列模型，用于识别结构断点和干预后趋势。实证结果显示，早在2014年3月后的制裁体制下，欧盟制裁对维谢格拉德国家向俄罗斯的出口已产生强烈负面影响，尤其对机械和电气设备等受高度制裁的制成品组影响显著，并在2022年2月后制裁大幅扩展后进一步加剧。进口影响最初较弱，但从2022年起显著增强，最突出的是能源类产品。研究结果揭示了针对不同制裁事件的贸易反应差异、产品组间的显著异质性，以及出口与进口调整之间的明显不对称性。

title: Behavioral responses to inheritance taxes: Evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 遗产税的行为反应：来自巴西的证据
abstract: I examine behavioral responses to inheritance and gift taxes in a setting where individuals knew the tax would increase three months before the new tax code took effect. Using tax microdata from Brazil, I employ bunching and difference-in-differences (DD) methods and find that individuals significantly retime their wealth transfers to avoid taxes. Retimed gifts resulted in smaller inheritances for nearly three years. Moreover, I find that responses are sensitive to changes in top gift marginal tax rates and tax design (flat rates vs progressive brackets). Finally, evasion increased in the medium run in reform states, particularly among small inheritances.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在个人知晓遗产税与赠与税将在三个月后上调的背景下，其行为反应。利用巴西的税收微观数据，采用聚束分析与双重差分法，发现个人显著调整财富转移时间以规避税负。调整后的赠与行为导致近三年内遗产规模缩小。此外，研究显示，行为反应对最高赠与边际税率变动及税制设计（统一税率与累进税率）具有敏感性。最后，改革州的中期逃税行为有所增加，尤以小额遗产为甚。
